finalResult.nextParagraphText: “You’ve had enough already,” Jake said decisively, denying the poor hawk any more snacks for now. With Carmen gone, Jake considered what he should be doing next, and honestly... there was a lot to do.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “You better give me a call,” she smiled before walking out the door and shooting into the sky... after stealing yet another banana on the way, and the cheeky smile on her face when she did it only made matters worse.
